d: Addressing reporters at a White House press briefing alongside UFC chief Dana White, US President Donald Trump stated that military engagement with Iran was nearing conclusion while asserting that American forces remain 'locked and loaded' should operations resume. Donald Trump dismissed speculation over White House appointments, clarifying that his proposal to designate Dana White as press secretary was made in jest.
